statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Weekend closure leaves current Tail at 19% while geopolitical and energy-route Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains EA_ON; Tail is below the WATCH threshold because live NQ price-path evidence is unavailable during the weekend closure.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while Gulf energy-route risk stays extreme
body: NQ futures remain closed. A fresh Strait of Hormuz vessel strike, the Saudi East-West pipeline shutdown and Bab el-Mandeb disruption keep Stress at 100%. These are material reopening-gap catalysts, but without observed one-way NQ structure they do not establish pathological mean-reversion failure.
